_note: Wires for the Indigenous peoples feed. harvest_indigenous.py reads this and writes wire_indigenous.json. Each wire carries a 'standing': official (UN bodies, courts, state agencies), research, indigenous (Indigenous-run and Indigenous-focused media and organisations), field (conservation and human-rights field press), or press. Indigenous-run outlets are labelled as such and can be filtered on their own. Locale coverage is expanded by the same market-and-slice method as the other feeds. Locale coverage is expanded: several country editions per language, and each query split into slices so no single search hits Google News's ~100-result cap.
